c74object.name: el.dmach~
c74object.digest: Multi-channel drum pattern sequencer and trigger generator
c74object.description:
el.dmach~ is a sample-accurate rhythm sequencer designed to drive buffer players (such as play~, groove~, or el.bvplay~). For each drum voice, it outputs a pair of signals: an attack trigger impulse (scaled by velocity) and a playback increment (pitch/speed factor). It supports complex polyrhythmic subdivisions, pattern chaining, dynamic tempo scaling, and per-voice transposition and gain control.
Inlets
Inlet 1 [Left Inlet] (signal / messages): Sync click input and control message inlet. Accepts configuration, pattern-editing, and sequencing messages.
Outlets
Outlets 1 to 2N (signal): Interleaved Trigger and Increment outlet pairs for each drum voice (Voice 1 Trigger, Voice 1 Increment, Voice 2 Trigger, Voice 2 Increment, etc.). Trigger outlets emit single-sample velocity clicks; Increment outlets emit pitch/speed factors.
Second-to-Rightmost Outlet (signal): Sync trigger. Emits an impulse at the start of each bar or pattern cycle.
Rightmost Outlet (list): Raw pattern data output. Emits complete pattern specifications formatted as readraw messages when queried with listraw.

inlet.digest: (signal/messages) Sync click input and message inlet
inlet.description: Accepts all pattern definitions, playback commands, and timing messages.

outlet.description: Outputs single-sample velocity impulses for Voice 1 attacks.
Outputs playback speed/transposition increment values for Voice 1 (sampled-and-held or clicks).

outlet.digest: (signal) Additional voice trigger and increment pairs
outlet.description: Interleaved trigger and increment signal outlets for remaining voices.
Emits a sample-rate impulse at the beginning of each bar or pattern cycle.
Emits complete pattern data formatted as a readraw message when requested via listraw.

objarg.name: tempo
objarg.description: Initial playback tempo in beats per minute (default: 120.0).

objarg.name: voices
objarg.description: The number of drum voice channels to allocate (default: 8). Each voice creates two signal outlets: a trigger output and an increment output.

method.name: arm
method.digest: Prime pattern to start at beat zero
method.description: Mutes the sequencer and cues the specified pattern slot to play from the beginning on the next sequence start.

method.name: clickincr
method.description: When set to 1, increment values are output as single-sample clicks aligned with attacks. When set to 0 (default), increment values are held continuously until the next attack.

method.name: copypattern
method.description: Copies the full pattern specification from source-slot to destination-slot.

method.name: gain
method.description: Sets an amplitude scaling factor for a specific drum voice slot (0-indexed, default: 1.0).

method.name: listraw
method.description: Dumps the complete definition of the specified pattern (or the current pattern if omitted) out the rightmost list outlet as a readraw message.

method.name: loopsequence
method.description: Initiates continuous looped playback of the provided list of pattern slot numbers.

method.name: muteslot
method.description: Mutes (1) or unmutes (0) trigger and increment output for a specific drum voice (0-indexed). All voices are unmuted by default.

method.name: nosequence
method.description: Stops playback of any active pattern sequence.

method.name: playsequence
method.description: Plays the provided list of pattern slot numbers in order once, then stops.

method.name: printraw
method.digest: Print raw pattern data to console
method.description: Prints the complete specification of the given pattern to the Max Console in a format compatible with readraw.

method.name: readraw
method.description: Loads a pattern definition into memory from data formatted by listraw or printraw.

method.name: recall
method.description: Queues the specified pattern slot to play when the current pattern reaches its end.

method.name: show
method.description: Prints a human-readable breakdown of attacks, increments, and trigger timing for the specified pattern to the Max Console.

method.name: slotamps
method.digest: Set uniform attack pattern for a slot
method.description: Defines the attacks for a given drum slot across a uniform subdivision of the bar. Arguments: pattern_number, slot_number, subdivision, [amplitude_values...]. A value of 0 specifies a rest; non-zero values set velocity. All attack increments default to 1.0.

method.name: slotampsfull
method.digest: Set multi-segment attack pattern for a slot
method.description: Defines attacks for a voice slot across irregular or multi-segment metric subdivisions. Format: pattern_number, slot_number, [beat_segment, subdivision, amplitudes...]....

method.name: slotincrs
method.digest: Set playback increments for attacks in a slot
method.description: Assigns playback speed/transposition increments to the active attacks created with slotamps or slotampsfull. Supply one increment value per active attack (rests do not take an increment value).

method.name: store
method.description: Stores a pattern to a given pattern slot. Can define the beat duration alone as a stub for piecemeal editing, or provide complete slot, subdivision, attack, and increment data.

method.name: tempo
method.description: Sets playback tempo in beats per minute. Internal attack positions across all patterns and active playback maintain phase synchronization under continuous tempo changes.

method.name: transpose
method.description: Sets a master transposition scalar for a given drum voice slot (0-indexed, default: 1.0). All increment values emitted by this slot are multiplied by this factor.
